confirm.title: Is this you?
confirm.lead: This code is for one person only. Check that this is your name.

notMe.title: This code is not yours
notMe.lead: It is personal and belongs to: {name}. Please leave the paper where it was, or give it to the right person.
notMe.help: Do you want your own code? Ask the OpenCouncil team.

email.title: Tell us your email
email.lead: We will send you a message with a button. You press it and continue. You do not need a password.
email.label: Your email
email.invalid: This does not look like an email. Check it and try again.
email.sendFailed: We could not send the message. Try again in a moment.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.step3: Press the button in the message.
sent.spam: You do not see it? Wait a minute, and look in the spam folder too.
sent.close: You can close this page. The button in the email brings you back, to the last step.

consent.title: Recognition of your voice
consent.lead: Your account is now linked to your page. One question is left.
consent.explain: OpenCouncil can make a voiceprint from one of your speeches in a meeting. With it, the system identifies the speaker correctly in later meetings.
consent.yesHint: I consent to the processing of my voice for a voiceprint.
consent.noHint: Nothing changes. You can consent later from your profile.
consent.error: Your choice was not saved. Try again.

done.title: All done
done.lead: Your account is now linked to your page on OpenCouncil.

problem.invalidTitle: This QR code does not work
problem.invalid: The code has expired or is not correct. Ask the OpenCouncil team for a new one.
problem.notFound: This code points to a person who no longer exists.
problem.usedTitle: This QR code is no longer valid
problem.used: An account has already been created for: {name}. Each code works only once.
problem.usedHelp: If you did not create it, contact the OpenCouncil team.
